N01-VFP-INDEPENDENT.rationale: Core and VFP parameter allocation are independent. A caller may forward an already live s0 rather than explicitly rewrite it in the unconsumed-write window. Preserve the existing float parameters; all three representative provider bodies actually consume their floats.

N02-IPC-AND-WIDE-FORWARDING.rationale: Transport and tail wrappers forward pointer/scalar/byte inputs, including stack-resident 64-bit tokens and later stack inputs. A call clears the local pending-write window, and a register forwarded unchanged has no new local write. None of these notes authorizes removing the real forwarded input.

N03-CPP-AND-AGGREGATE-OWNERS.rationale: Retain the actual owner, by-value iterator, color component, constructor/storage and native bridge contracts. The C parser does not establish C++ member interfaces, and absence of an immediate caller write does not turn an owner into a no-argument function. Representative providers dereference their real receiver, preserve the iterator storage, assemble color from every input or forward their output/resource arguments. This grouped adjudication is not a new blanket C++ type waiver.

N04-SELECTORS-OUTPUTS-AND-CONSUMED-SETUP.rationale: Retain typed selectors, counts, indices and writable-output parameters. Setup already read for address calculation, a conditional, or an earlier call is deliberately removed by argcheck from the unconsumed-write set; that does not mean the argument is absent at the eventual call. Representative source/original provider witnesses use these values in the downstream command/count/index/output operations.

N05-RETAIN-EXISTING-RECEIVER-OR-PAYLOAD.rationale: Retain the existing receiver/payload/handle/table contracts. These are notes only: they establish that the bounded caller window has no explicit unconsumed preparation, not that the value is dead or the formal wrong. Representative original providers access the incoming object/table and source bodies retain those fields or forward the object. Existing matched/manual contract evidence is not replaced by an absence heuristic.
